review.tdd: Prior S15 semantic REDs preceded durable producer routing, owner-unavailable fallback, and transient replace recovery. The seven-field correction has semantic RED assertions for save_document (S14 assertion 2) and configured-store producer (S15 assertion 7), then passes at the frozen hash. The manual IPC and source/bundle stdio additions are entrypoint regressions; the source-dispatch assertion-36 RED was a coverage/fixture failure because that production branch was unchanged. No existing test assertion was removed or weakened. S09 now supplies the configured ingress root and uses a test-only startup replay hold to preserve its fault windows; S10 still exercises production startup replay.
review.entrypoints: The source and generated-bundle MCP servers are launched with SDK stdio clients. Their open_markdown and update_markdown calls traverse the real index.js handleIpcMessage and sendResponse functions over a local IPC socket; the fixture replaces Electron windows and owner transport, not the dispatch implementation. The registered renderer mcp-manual-save IPC callback is invoked with a window entry. Each configured-store mutation produces one owner acceptance call, and legacy markDirty is rejected by the fixture.
review.durability: A post-publication owner failure leaves the final Markdown and body-free private intent, while preserving the visible window identity, title, content, saved-path signal, and existing MCP or renderer response shape. Save-document, configured-store, and external registrar producers send exactly the seven private accept_save fields without raw publication or ingress roots. The controller strips legacy root fields before the worker command; the worker uses configured roots, compares supplied identity with the private intent, and returns the committed receipt for an intentId-only replay while rejecting a wrong root fingerprint. The real owner regression verifies one documentId and the latest desired revision, content hash, and current job after two updates. The S16 checkpoint covers external renderer save-as through a separate contained copy and removes its legacy enqueue. No new product-main SQLite write appears in the final diff.
review.readOnlyAndCompatibility: A documentId stdio open adds no final file, private intent, owner call, or saved-path signal in either source or bundle fixture. The adjacent indexed-origin test covers real resolver behavior. Exact eight-tool and source/HTTP/bundle schema tests pass; the final diff does not change public tool definitions, response fields, or errors.
review.scope: Issue 38 completion criteria are supported by the combined S15 and S16 evidence. This review does not promote the broader REL-DOC-009 requirement to verified or claim a full packaged Electron smoke run.
